name: Neutrophils (absolute count)
rangeNote: Many healthy people with African or Middle Eastern family roots carry a common gene variant (called Duffy-null) that makes their usual neutrophil count lower, sometimes below this range, without more infections. Separate ranges for them exist, so ask which range fits you.
summary: Neutrophils are the most common white blood cells and the first to respond to bacterial infections. This value is how many are in a set volume of blood, which says more than their percentage.

high.meaning: A high count is most often a short-term reaction to infection, inflammation or stress. It usually settles once the cause passes.
commonCauses: Physical or emotional stress, or hard exercise

low.meaning: A mildly low count is common after viral infections or with some medicines, and can be normal for some people. A very low count (below 0.5) makes serious infections more likely, so a fever at such a count needs urgent medical care.
commonCauses: Natural variation (Duffy-null), common in people of African or Middle Eastern descent
